title.hr: Signali: SIGTERM, SIGKILL, SIGHUP i nohup
title.en: Signals: SIGTERM, SIGKILL, SIGHUP and nohup

concept.hr: Postupanje sa signalom odlučuje: zadana radnja, zanemari ili uhvati
concept.en: The disposition decides: default action, ignore, or catch

summary.hr: Pošalji signale procesima sa i bez funkcije za hvatanje: kill šalje SIGTERM, SIGKILL se ne da uhvatiti, a nohup štiti samo od SIGHUP-a.
summary.en: Send signals to processes with and without handlers: kill sends SIGTERM, SIGKILL cannot be caught, and nohup guards only against SIGHUP.
